text: Ko onon yo ɓen gomɗimɓe Allah jokki nulaaɗo Makko on! Ñaamee imoorde e laaɓuɗi ɗi Allah Arsiki on O Daginani on, jaarniron Allah kene e gunndoo fii ko O Teddiniri on neemaaji. Hino jeyaa e jaarnugo Mo kaŋko Toowuɗo On, ɗoftagol yamiraaɗi Makko, woɗɗitoo haɗaaɗi Makko; si on wanii rewirayɓe Mo kaŋko tan e hoore goonga, hara on kafidaali Mo hay e huunde.
